title: 렌즈가 꺼진 뒤
suno_analysis_sp: K-Rock with pop-punk influences. Distorted electric guitars play palm-muted eighth notes in the verses and open power chords in the chorus. A driving drum kit features a prominent crash cymbal on the downbeats and a consistent eighth-note hi-hat pattern. The bass guitar follows the root notes of the guitar progression with a picked attack. Male vocals are delivered with a clean, melodic tone, shifting to a more strained, emotive belt in the higher register during the chorus. The arrangement features a sudden dynamic shift from a relatively sparse verse to a dense, wall-of-sound chorus. Tempo is 145 BPM in 4/4 time, key of E major.
suno_analysis_lyrics:
[Intro]
[distorted electric guitar riff, driving drums]

[Verse 1]
[palm-muted electric guitar, bass, and drums]
조명이 뜨거워 땀이 마르고 있어
심사위원 세 명이 앞에 앉아 있잖아
노래를 불렀어 최선이었어
결과를 기다리고 있어
심사위원이 입을 열어
아쉽지만 그 뒤의 말은 안 들렸어

[Chorus]
[full band, open power chords, heavy crash cymbals]
카메라가 돌아가고 있어 빨간 불이 켜져 있어
어떤 표정을 해야 하지
우는 건 너무 많고 웃는 건 거짓이고
고개를 끄덕였어
감사합니다를 말했어
